tests.environment: Linux, Python 3.11, Chromium and ffmpeg available, heavy ML packages not installed

compatibility.http: URL, methods and endpoint names unchanged (tests/fixtures/route_map.json)
compatibility.database_and_files: No schema, stored-format, ID or Vault-layout change
compatibility.app_module_names: Names tests, scripts and the Colab notebook use as app.<name> remain importable from gurumoji.app

guards.protects: Patched app.<name> reaches web/ and handlers/ code
create_app() has no data side effects

modules.src/gurumoji/app.py: Composition root: settings/paths, runtime-state aliases, dependency wiring (late-bound), create_app(), main().
modules.src/gurumoji/runtime_state.py: RuntimeState: in-memory jobs, shared locks, analysis cancel events; job pruning and progress updates.
modules.src/gurumoji/diagnostics.py: Redaction of local filesystem paths from diagnostics sent to remote clients.
modules.src/gurumoji/web/security.py: before/after-request hooks: trusted Host, remote auth, cross-site/CSRF, per-endpoint body limits, security headers.
modules.src/gurumoji/web/library_routes.py: Library list/get/create, media, files, thumbnails, input selection, interview comparison.
modules.src/gurumoji/web/library_deletion.py: DELETE /api/library/<id> body with quarantine and restore.
modules.src/gurumoji/web/analysis_view_routes.py: Analysis view, annotations, experts, KWIC, semantic search.
modules.src/gurumoji/handlers/transcription_star: Validate a transcription request, reserve folders, start the worker.
modules.src/gurumoji/handlers/speaker_identifica: Re-run AI speaker identification for a saved conversation.
modules.src/gurumoji/services/library_schema.py: SQLite schema creation and in-place upgrades.
modules.src/gurumoji/services/library_edits.py: Edited-transcript validation and the locked update with edit manifest.
modules.src/gurumoji/services/analysis_annotatio: Analysis settings/annotation save with codebook versioning.
modules.src/gurumoji/services/output_import.py: Import of existing output files with provenance/tombstones.
modules.src/gurumoji/services/media_files.py: Media staging, thumbnails, output roots, local media paths.
modules.src/gurumoji/services/ai/settings.py: TokenConfig, token file, provider labels, model discovery, LM Studio probes.
modules.src/gurumoji/services/speaker_identifica: AI speaker-name detection, identity repairs, registry linking.
modules.src/gurumoji/services/analysis_jobs.py: AI-insight and Transformer runners and start/cancel commands.
modules.src/gurumoji/services/analysis_archive.p: archive_* conversions into immutable AnalysisStore runs.
modules.src/gurumoji/services/analysis_pipeline_: Pipeline snapshot, step adapter, O01 plan adviser.
modules.src/gurumoji/services/transcription/diar: pyannote setup and Hugging Face access diagnostics.
modules.src/gurumoji/services/transcription/voca: Custom vocabulary storage and Whisper prompt.
